task_title: Board shrink check on the commit path (tasks.jsonl row-loss guard)
task_criteria: AC1: commit refuses a board shrink (exit 1, both counts + lost ids, commit not landed). AC2: legitimate append/in-place edit passes. AC3: BOARD_ALLOW_SHRINK=1 override passes and still names counts+lost ids. AC4: the truncating lane close writer is fixed or quarantined so it never reduces rows. AC5: boardctl validate RESULT OK on repaired board and scratch copy.

items.criterion: AC1: commit refuses a board shrink (exit 1, both counts + lost ids, commit not landed). AC2: legitimate append/in-place edit passes. AC3: BOARD_ALLOW_SHRINK=1 override passes and still names counts+lost ids. AC4: the truncating lane close writer is fixed or quarantined so it never reduces rows. AC5: boardctl validate RESULT OK on repaired board and scratch copy.
items.detail: AC1: scripts/board_shrink_check.py:170-186 exits 1 with 'REFUSED baseline=<old> candidate=<new> lost ids=...'; the live hook .git/hooks/pre-commit:2-9 runs the checker whenever the board is staged; tests/test_board_shrink_check.py::test_shrink_is_refused_and_the_commit_does_not_land asserts exit 1, 'baseline=3 candidate=1 lost ids=B, C', and HEAD unchanged, and test_deleting_the_board_is_refused covers board deletion. AC2: test_append_and_same_count_edit_pass + test_adding_the_board_for_the_first_time_passes prove append and in-place edit exit 0; live run `python3 scripts/board_shrink_check.py` on this worktree printed 'OK baseline=298 candidate=298' exit 0. AC3: board_shrink_check.py:171-177 turns BOARD_ALLOW_SHRINK=1 into a printed NOTICE that still names both counts and every lost id ('SHRINK ACCEPTED — N task row(s) dropped'); test_override_lands_and_still_names_counts_and_ids asserts NOTICE + 'baseline=3 candidate=1 lost ids=B, C' and that the pruned board landed. AC4 (quarantine leg): the 45a29b9 writer was an ad-hoc lane-session snippet (git show 45a29b9 --numstat: 2 added/297 deleted, survivors exactly the two closed rows INT-CI-001+AUG-191, commit message discloses --no-verify), not a tracked writer — verified by grep over repo *.py/*.sh (only readers/auditors) and by reading the foreman skill writers (board_row_closeout.py:104-131 line-wise byte-preserving; append_board_task_dispatched.py:155-164 and update_board_task_notes.py:100-115 rewrite the whole loaded list, never a filtered subset); the quarantine is the installed pre-commit block + ci.yml:71 '--recent' step + the replay test test_the_real_297_row_board_rewrite_is_quarantined. AC5: `boardctl validate` on the real board printed 'RESULT: OK (439 warning(s))' exit 0; a scratch copy (mktemp dir with tasks.jsonl+events.jsonl+board.jsonl) printed 'RESULT: OK (439 warning(s))' exit 0. Suite evidence: `.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/test_board_shrink_check.py` -> '19 passed in 2.06s' exit 0; ruff 0.15.22 'All checks passed!' on the three new files.

items.criterion: Derived: the shrink check is reachable from this repo's actual commit path — the managed block is installed in the live pre-commit hook and fires exactly when the board is staged
items.detail: .git/hooks/pre-commit:2-9 contains the '# >>> board-shrink managed block >>>' running `python3 "scripts/board_shrink_check.py" || exit 1` gated on `git diff --cached --name-only -- .coding-hermes/board/tasks.jsonl`; `git config core.hooksPath` is empty so .git/hooks/pre-commit is the live hook; test_the_hook_only_checks_when_the_board_is_staged proves with a stub checker that unrelated commits skip it and a staged board write runs it (in the 19-passed run).

items.criterion: Derived: the proof suite is wired into the repo's real test surfaces (gate pytest arm and CI) so the 19 tests are actually executed
items.detail: tests/gate.sh:244 pytest arm names tests/test_board_shrink_check.py; .github/workflows/ci.yml:71 runs `python3 scripts/board_shrink_check.py --recent` before the gate step with fetch-depth: 0 checkout, and ci.yml:149 runs `python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_board_shrink_check.py`; test_the_gate_pytest_arm_names_this_file, test_the_real_workflow_runs_the_check and four ci.yml mutation legs assert this wiring (19 passed). Full `bash tests/gate.sh` not runnable here — it requires a live DuckBrain (tier1 tests arm: 'ERROR: DuckBrain URL missing', exit 2) — so the focused suite was run directly instead.

items.criterion: Derived: fail-closed seam — an unreadable/unresolvable baseline (shallow clone, unmerged path, torn row) exits 1 rather than passing blind
items.detail: board_shrink_check.py:88-96 raises naming 'git fetch --deepen=1' when HEAD^ is unresolvable, :100-104 refuses an unmerged index path, :163-169 exits 1 on parse failures; tests test_missing_parent_fails_closed_naming_the_deepen_hint and test_override_does_not_excuse_a_parse_failure (19 passed); live spot check `python3 scripts/board_shrink_check.py --path .gitreins/tasks.yaml` -> parse-failure refusal, exit=1.
